title: Prime next-day delivery promises broken due to dispatch delays
situation: 5 customers including 1 VIP are complaining about delayed Prime deliveries, risking SAR 444.
hypothesis: Logistics hub system outage causing dispatch halts

actions.reply_en: We missed your next-day delivery date. We are checking your shipment right now and will update you within 24 hours.
actions.reply_ar: لم نلتزم بموعد التوصيل في اليوم التالي. نتابع شحنتك الآن وسنوافيك بالتحديث خلال 24 ساعة.
actions.why: Acknowledge the delayed delivery and set a clear timeline.
Goodwill credit for the broken delivery promise.

actions.note: Dispatch halts affecting Prime next-day delivery SLAs for 5 customers.

alternatives.hypothesis: Carrier network capacity overload causing regional backlogs
alternatives.why: Delays could stem from external carrier bottlenecks rather than hub issues.

alternatives.hypothesis: Incorrect inventory stock levels showing false availability
alternatives.why: Items might be backordered despite showing as available for next-day dispatch.
